physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Abell S1063 is recorded here: its package frames it at 430,016 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at its distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), Abell S1063: position from 2015ApJS..216...27B, redshift from 2024MNRAS.531.3973K (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=Abell%20S1063); NED preferred values of Abell S1063: RA 342.1907°, Dec -44.5269° (2015ApJS..216...27B); redshift 0.35166 ± 0.004934 (2024MNRAS.531.3973K)
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the redshift z = 0.35166 (NED, 2024MNRAS.531.3973K) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 1425199032.337357 pc, from Astropy 8.0.1 Planck18.comoving_distance (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209). The project's convention for objects placed by redshift (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the object is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for the redshift z = 0.35166: the redshift written as a velocity, not a motion through space. NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), Abell S1063: position from 2015ApJS..216...27B, redshift from 2024MNRAS.531.3973K (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=Abell%20S1063).
